methodology: One warm-up followed by 10 independent full Engine 0.4 runs; nearest-rank median and p95. Full artifact hash, event count, trace count, and final checksum agreed in every run.
uncertainty: Observed range was 36.294 ms (3.89% of median). Timing comparisons apply only to the same environment; artifact identity is cross-platform. Engine 0.4 meets the 1,000 ms Phase 2 target and remains inside the separate 1,300 ms same-environment regression ceiling.
